author: David Scripka / openWakeWord
melspectrogram: C++ oww_melspectrogram; melspectrogram.onnx is not shipped

embedding.format: OWWEMBD1 v2 native blob, int8 per-channel weights + fp32 first conv (tools/oww_embedding_blob); embedding_model.onnx is not shipped, reference copy under .oww-hosttest/ref

classifier_io: Classifier tensor names carry a per-model hash suffix; bind by index, not by name.
audio_scale: int16-range float32; do not normalise to +/-1
